english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for pressing something between sides, and in 夾喺 A 同 B 之間 for being caught between competing choices.

examples.english: I squeeze the sponge with my hand to get the water out.
examples.traditional: 我用手夾住塊海綿，將啲水擠出嚟。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gaap3 zyu6 faai3 hoi2 min4 zoeng1 di1 seoi2 zai1 ceot1 lai4

english.note: Use this everyday verb when people, ideas, styles, or other elements go well together.
Use 夾 as the all-purpose everyday choice when people, ideas, or interests go well together.

examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 gei2 gaap3

examples.english: I match really well with Ah Ming.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 gei2 gaap3 gaa3

english.note: Use this when something suits or agrees with a person’s body, taste, or constitution, especially food or medicine.

examples.english: I agree that this medicine suits my stomach.
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 gaap3 ngo5 go3 wai6
